decisions.reason: As a small accessory closely tied to the trailer business and after-sales service, it is likely to stay if it has remained in the range through 2022, though accessories are easier to streamline than vehicle lines.
This box car trailer series is a core transport product for the firm and its continued presence after several years suggests stable demand and strategic importance.
The low-bed trailer series fits the firm's core hauling portfolio well and supports serving varied transport tasks, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn absent a clear performance issue.
The high trailer cover series complements the main trailer range and supports cross-selling, although add-on product families remain somewhat easier to rationalize than full trailer series.
This box car trailer series still fits the firm's core market, but overlap with another box trailer line keeps portfolio consolidation as the main withdrawal risk.
